```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(DESeq2)
})

find_project_root <- function(start = NULL) {
  candidates <- c(
    Sys.getenv("SKIN_MAPPING_PROJECT_ROOT", unset = NA_character_),
    if (exists("params") && !is.null(params$project_root)) params$project_root else NA_character_,
    getwd()
  )
  candidates <- candidates[!is.na(candidates) & nzchar(candidates)]

  for (candidate in candidates) {
    current <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    for (i in seq_len(8)) {
      if (dir.exists(file.path(current, "data", "external"))) {
        return(current)
      }
      parent <- dirname(current)
      if (identical(parent, current)) break
      current <- parent
    }
  }
  stop("Could not find project root containing data/external")
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
data_dir <- file.path(project_root, "data", "external")
out_dir <- file.path(project_root, "results", "260727", "gtex_bulk_skin_qc")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

gct_files <- c(
  "Skin - Sun Exposed (Lower leg)" =
    file.path(data_dir, "gene_reads_adult_gtex_v11_skin_sun_exposed_lower_leg.gct.gz"),
  "Skin - Not Sun Exposed (Suprapubic)" =
    file.path(data_dir, "gene_reads_adult_gtex_v11_skin_not_sun_exposed_suprapubic.gct.gz")
)

subject_pheno_path <- file.path(data_dir, "GTEx_Analysis_v11_Annotations_SubjectPhenotypesDS.txt")
sample_attr_path <- file.path(data_dir, "GTEx_Analysis_v11_Annotations_SampleAttributesDS.txt")
hpa_secreted_gene_path <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "results", "260727", "sinai_age_decade_trends_all_sites",
  "hpa_predicted_secreted_gene_list.csv"
)

age_levels <- c("20-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70-79", "80-89")
sex_labels <- c("1" = "Male", "2" = "Female")

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 12))
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helpers}
read_gct_counts <- function(path) {
  counts_dt <- fread(path, skip = 2)
  sample_ids <- setdiff(colnames(counts_dt), c("Name", "Description"))
  count_mat <- as.matrix(counts_dt[, ..sample_ids])
  storage.mode(count_mat) <- "integer"
  rownames(count_mat) <- make.unique(as.character(counts_dt$Name))
  list(
    counts = count_mat,
    sample_ids = sample_ids,
    gene_ids = as.character(counts_dt$Name),
    gene_symbols = as.character(counts_dt$Description)
  )
}

prepare_ensembl_counts <- function(gct) {

  ensembl_versioned <- as.character(gct$gene_ids)
  ensembl_id <- sub("\\..*$", "", ensembl_versioned)
  gene_symbol <- as.character(gct$gene_symbols)

  keep <- (
    !is.na(gene_symbol) &
    gene_symbol != ""
  )

  counts <- gct$counts[
    keep,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  ensembl_versioned <- ensembl_versioned[keep]
  ensembl_id <- ensembl_id[keep]
  gene_symbol <- gene_symbol[keep]

  # Make symbols unique WITHOUT collapsing rows
  gene_symbol_unique <- make.unique(gene_symbol, sep = ".")

  rownames(counts) <- gene_symbol_unique
  counts
}

estimate_deseq2_size_factors <- function(count_mat) {
  count_mat <- count_mat[rowSums(count_mat) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  col_data <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(count_mat), sample_id = colnames(count_mat))
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = count_mat,
    colData = col_data,
    design = ~ 1
  )
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  tibble(
    sample_id = names(sizeFactors(dds)),
    deseq2_size_factor = as.numeric(sizeFactors(dds))
  )
}

summarize_count_qc <- function(site, path) {
  gct <- read_gct_counts(path)
  count_mat <- gct$counts
  size_factors <- estimate_deseq2_size_factors(count_mat)

  tibble(
    sample_id = colnames(count_mat),
    bulk_skin_site = site,
    total_counts = as.numeric(colSums(count_mat)),
    detected_genes = as.numeric(colSums(count_mat > 0)),
    n_genes_in_matrix = nrow(count_mat)
  ) %>%
    left_join(size_factors, by = "sample_id")
}

save_plot <- function(plot, filename, width = 10, height = 6) {
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(filename, ".png")), plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(filename, ".pdf")), plot, width = width, height = height)
  plot
}
```

## Sample Metadata

```{r metadata}
subject_pheno <- fread(subject_pheno_path) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    donor_id = SUBJID,
    age_bin = factor(AGE, levels = age_levels, ordered = TRUE),
    sex = recode(as.character(SEX), !!!sex_labels, .default = as.character(SEX))
  ) %>%
  select(donor_id, sex, age_bin, DTHHRDY)

sample_attr <- fread(sample_attr_path) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    sample_id = SAMPID,
    donor_id = str_extract(SAMPID, "^GTEX-[^-]+"),
    sample_tissue = SMTSD,
    tissue_major = SMTS,
    rin = as.numeric(SMRIN),
    center = SMCENTER,
    ischemic_time = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(SMTSISCH)),
    extraction_batch = SMNABTCH,
    sequencing_batch = SMGEBTCH
  )
```

## Per-Sample QC Table

```{r qc-table, message=TRUE}
qc <- bind_rows(lapply(names(gct_files), function(site) {
  message("Reading and summarizing: ", site)
  summarize_count_qc(site, gct_files[[site]])
})) %>%
  left_join(sample_attr, by = "sample_id") %>%
  left_join(subject_pheno, by = "donor_id") %>%
  mutate(
    age_bin = factor(age_bin, levels = age_levels, ordered = TRUE),
    log10_total_counts = log10(total_counts + 1),
    log10_detected_genes = log10(detected_genes + 1),
    log10_size_factor = log10(deseq2_size_factor)
  )

write_csv(qc, file.path(out_dir, "gtex_bulk_skin_sample_qc.csv"))

qc_summary <- qc %>%
  group_by(bulk_skin_site) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_donors = n_distinct(donor_id),
    median_total_counts = median(total_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_detected_genes = median(detected_genes, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rin = median(rin, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_size_factor = median(deseq2_size_factor, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(qc_summary)
```

## Potential Outlier Flags

```{r outlier-flags}
qc_flags <- qc %>%
  group_by(bulk_skin_site) %>%
  mutate(
    total_counts_z = as.numeric(scale(log10_total_counts)),
    detected_genes_z = as.numeric(scale(log10_detected_genes)),
    size_factor_z = as.numeric(scale(log10_size_factor)),
    low_total_counts = total_counts_z < -3,
    low_detected_genes = detected_genes_z < -3,
    extreme_size_factor = abs(size_factor_z) > 3,
    low_rin = !is.na(rin) & rin < 5,
    qc_flag = low_total_counts | low_detected_genes | extreme_size_factor | low_rin
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(qc_flags, file.path(out_dir, "gtex_bulk_skin_sample_qc_with_flags.csv"))

flag_summary <- qc_flags %>%
  dplyr::count(bulk_skin_site, qc_flag, name = "n_samples")

kable(flag_summary)
```

```{r flagged-samples}
flagged_samples <- qc_flags %>%
  filter(qc_flag) %>%
  select(
    sample_id, donor_id, bulk_skin_site, age_bin, sex, rin,
    total_counts, detected_genes, deseq2_size_factor,
    low_total_counts, low_detected_genes, extreme_size_factor, low_rin
  ) %>%
  arrange(bulk_skin_site, age_bin, sample_id)

kable(flagged_samples)
```

## Reusable DESeq2 Objects for Age-Trend Analysis

```{r save-deseq2-objects, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}



# ============================================================
# Helper: create a fitted DESeq2 object
#
# Primary question:
#   Which genes show increasing expression with age?
#
# age_numeric:
#   20-29 -> 1
#   30-39 -> 2
#   ...
#   80-89 -> 7
#
# Therefore:
#   positive age_numeric coefficient = increases with age
# ============================================================
message("Loading GTEx count matrices...")

gct_data <- lapply(
  gct_files,
  read_gct_counts
)

make_age_deseq_object <- function(
    site_names,
    qc,
    gct_data,
    include_site = FALSE
) {

  count_list <- list()

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Read raw counts for requested skin site(s)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  for (site in site_names) {

    message("Preparing counts for: ", site)

    gct <- gct_data[[site]]

    counts <- prepare_ensembl_counts(gct)

    count_list[[site]] <- counts
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Ensure all site matrices use the same gene universe
  #
  # Do NOT remove zero-count genes before this step because a
  # gene may be expressed in one skin site but not the other.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  common_genes <- Reduce(
    intersect,
    lapply(
      count_list,
      rownames
    )
  )

  count_list <- lapply(
    count_list,
    function(x) {

      x[
        common_genes,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

    }
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Combine samples across requested site(s)
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  counts <- do.call(
    cbind,
    count_list
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Remove genes with no expression across the entire analysis
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  counts <- counts[
    rowSums(counts) > 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Construct DESeq2 sample metadata
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  col_data <- qc %>%

    filter(
      bulk_skin_site %in% site_names,
      sample_id %in% colnames(counts)
    ) %>%

    distinct(
      sample_id,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    ) %>%

    mutate(

      # Ordered decade number for testing an age-dependent trend
      age_numeric = match(
        as.character(age_bin),
        age_levels
      ),

      sex = factor(
        sex
      ),

      bulk_skin_site = factor(
        bulk_skin_site
      ),

      rin = as.numeric(
        rin
      )
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # DESeq2 design variables cannot contain missing values.
  #
  # We currently adjust for:
  #   - age (variable of interest)
  #   - sex
  #   - RIN
  #   - skin site, when both sites are included
  #
  # ischemic_time, center, extraction_batch and
  # sequencing_batch remain in the metadata but are not in
  # the primary model unless later justified.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  col_data <- col_data %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(age_numeric),
      !is.na(sex),
      !is.na(rin)
    )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Put metadata into exactly the same order as count columns
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  col_data <- col_data %>%

    arrange(
      match(
        sample_id,
        colnames(counts)
      )
    )


  # Subset counts to samples retained after covariate filtering
  counts <- counts[
    ,
    col_data$sample_id,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Keep useful metadata in the DESeq2 object
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  col_data <- col_data %>%

    select(
      sample_id,
      donor_id,
      bulk_skin_site,
      age_bin,
      age_numeric,
      sex,
      rin,
      center,
      ischemic_time,
      extraction_batch,
      sequencing_batch,
      total_counts,
      detected_genes,
      deseq2_size_factor
    ) %>%

    as.data.frame()


  rownames(col_data) <- (
    col_data$sample_id
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Safety check
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  stopifnot(
    identical(
      rownames(col_data),
      colnames(counts)
    )
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Drop unused factor levels
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  col_data$sex <- droplevels(
    col_data$sex
  )

  col_data$bulk_skin_site <- droplevels(
    col_data$bulk_skin_site
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Define model
  #
  # AGE is deliberately the final term because it is our
  # coefficient of interest.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  if (include_site) {

    design_formula <- (
      ~ bulk_skin_site +
        sex +
        rin +
        age_numeric
    )

  } else {

    design_formula <- (
      ~ sex +
        rin +
        age_numeric
    )
  }


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Create DESeqDataSet
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = counts,
    colData = col_data,
    design = design_formula
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Standard DESeq2 median of ratios size factor estimation
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(
    dds
  )


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Fit the DESeq2 model now so downstream SSSP selection can
  # simply readRDS() and extract the age coefficient.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  dds <- DESeq(
    dds
  )


  return(dds)
}


# ============================================================
# Define analysis groups
#
# These are the ONLY two analyses:
#
# 1. Suprapubic only
# 2. Suprapubic + lower leg
# ============================================================

suprapubic_site <- (
  "Skin - Not Sun Exposed (Suprapubic)"
)

lower_leg_site <- (
  "Skin - Sun Exposed (Lower leg)"
)


# ============================================================
# 1. Suprapubic-only model
#
# expression ~ sex + RIN + age
# ============================================================

message(
  "Creating suprapubic-only DESeq2 object..."
)

dds_suprapubic <- make_age_deseq_object(

  site_names = c(
    suprapubic_site
  ),

  qc = qc,

  gct_data = gct_data,

  include_site = FALSE
)


message(
  "Suprapubic design: ",
  paste(
    deparse(
      design(dds_suprapubic)
    ),
    collapse = " "
  )
)


message(
  "Suprapubic result coefficients: ",
  paste(
    resultsNames(dds_suprapubic),
    collapse = ", "
  )
)


saveRDS(

  dds_suprapubic,

  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "gtex_skin_dds_age_suprapubic.rds"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# 2. Suprapubic + lower-leg model
#
# expression ~ site + sex + RIN + age
# ============================================================

message(
  "Creating suprapubic + lower-leg DESeq2 object..."
)

dds_combined <- make_age_deseq_object(

  site_names = c(
    suprapubic_site,
    lower_leg_site
  ),

  qc = qc,

  gct_data = gct_data,

  include_site = TRUE
)


message(
  "Combined design: ",
  paste(
    deparse(
      design(dds_combined)
    ),
    collapse = " "
  )
)


message(
  "Combined result coefficients: ",
  paste(
    resultsNames(dds_combined),
    collapse = ", "
  )
)


saveRDS(

  dds_combined,

  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "gtex_skin_dds_age_suprapubic_plus_lower_leg.rds"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# Optional: save age-effect result tables as a quick sanity
# check. The fitted DDS objects remain the canonical output.
# ============================================================

res_age_suprapubic <- results(
  dds_suprapubic,
  name = "age_numeric"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  arrange(
    padj
  )


write_csv(

  res_age_suprapubic,

  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "gtex_skin_deseq2_age_results_suprapubic.csv"
  )
)


res_age_combined <- results(
  dds_combined,
  name = "age_numeric"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")%>%
  arrange(
    padj
  )


write_csv(

  res_age_combined,

  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "gtex_skin_deseq2_age_results_suprapubic_plus_lower_leg.csv"
  )
)


# ============================================================
# Save a summary of the reusable objects
# ============================================================

dds_summary <- tibble(

  analysis = c(
    "suprapubic_only",
    "suprapubic_plus_lower_leg"
  ),

  file = c(
    "gtex_skin_dds_age_suprapubic.rds",
    "gtex_skin_dds_age_suprapubic_plus_lower_leg.rds"
  ),

  n_genes = c(
    nrow(dds_suprapubic),
    nrow(dds_combined)
  ),

  n_samples = c(
    ncol(dds_suprapubic),
    ncol(dds_combined)
  ),

  n_donors = c(
    n_distinct(
      colData(dds_suprapubic)$donor_id
    ),
    n_distinct(
      colData(dds_combined)$donor_id
    )
  ),

  design = c(
    "~ sex + rin + age_numeric",
    "~ bulk_skin_site + sex + rin + age_numeric"
  )
)


write_csv(

  dds_summary,

  file.path(
    out_dir,
    "gtex_skin_deseq2_age_object_summary.csv"
  )
)


kable(
  dds_summary
)


# ============================================================
# Save one consolidated reusable GTEx bulk-skin R object
#
# Counts and fitted model metadata are already contained in the DESeqDataSet
# objects, so the original GCT matrices are not duplicated in this bundle.
# ============================================================

object_dir <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "data",
  "public_validation"
)

dir.create(
  object_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

gtex_bulk_skin <- list(
  # Keep paths rather than embedding the two fitted objects again; the
  # canonical RDS files are ~3.3 GB and ~7.0 GB, respectively.
  dds_paths = list(
    suprapubic = file.path(
      out_dir,
      "gtex_skin_dds_age_suprapubic.rds"
    ),
    suprapubic_plus_lower_leg = file.path(
      out_dir,
      "gtex_skin_dds_age_suprapubic_plus_lower_leg.rds"
    )
  ),
  sample_qc = qc,
  sample_qc_with_flags = qc_flags,
  age_results_suprapubic = res_age_suprapubic,
  age_results_suprapubic_plus_lower_leg = res_age_combined,
  object_summary = dds_summary,
  site_names = list(
    suprapubic = suprapubic_site,
    lower_leg = lower_leg_site
  ),
  input_files = list(
    gct_files = gct_files,
    subject_phenotypes = subject_pheno_path,
    sample_attributes = sample_attr_path
  ),
  created_by = "code/public_validation/09_gtex_bulk_skin_qc.Rmd"
)

gtex_bulk_skin_object_path <- file.path(
  object_dir,
  "gtex_bulk_skin.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  gtex_bulk_skin,
  gtex_bulk_skin_object_path
)

message(
  "Saved consolidated GTEx bulk-skin R object: ",
  gtex_bulk_skin_object_path
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Export processed VST matrices + matching metadata
# for downstream Python SSSP selection
# ============================================================

export_vst_and_metadata <- function(dds, prefix, out_dir) {

  # dds has already been fitted with DESeq()
  vsd <- vst(
    dds,
    blind = FALSE
  )

  # Samples x genes
  vst_df <- assay(vsd) %>%
    t() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")

  write_csv(
    vst_df,
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(prefix, "_vst.csv.gz")
    )
  )


  # Use metadata directly from the same DDS so there is no
  # possibility of expression/metadata mismatch.
  metadata_df <- colData(dds) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  write_csv(
    metadata_df,
    file.path(
      out_dir,
      paste0(prefix, "_metadata.csv")
    )
  )
}


export_vst_and_metadata(
  dds_suprapubic,
  "gtex_skin_age_suprapubic",
  out_dir
)

export_vst_and_metadata(
  dds_combined,
  "gtex_skin_age_suprapubic_plus_lower_leg",
  out_dir
)
```
